meta.titulo: Used Porsche 968 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 968, Club Sport and Turbo S, from 1992 to 1995, the last four-cylinder transaxle. Inspected on 111 points, twelve-month warranty and certified mileage.

parrafos: The 968 is the final evolution of the 944: a 3.0-litre 16-valve with VarioCam and 240 hp, six-speed manual or Tiptronic, and a body with the nose of the 928. The Club Sport, lighter and stripped of luxuries, is the one purists look for; the Turbo S, with 305 hp and fourteen cars built, is a rarity.

It is the most modern transaxle and the most expensive, and it is worth it: it drives like a current car and is maintained like a classic. With the belts and the VarioCam checked it has no weak points.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 968 before selling it
items: Timing and balance belts, tensioners and water pump: date and mileage of the last change.
VarioCam chain tensioner: cold noises and condition of the guides.
Clutch and six-speed gearbox; on the Tiptronic, shift quality and leaks.
Cooling, oil leaks and condition of the hydraulic engine mounts.
Corrosion in wheel arches and underside, hood on the Cabriolet and originality on the Club Sport.

parrafos: Every Porsche 968 we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
